Cinema 4D Cheetah3D Unity3D Lightmap

Hello everyone,

Just wanted to post a big thankyou to Martin and Hiroto.

I purchased Cheetah3D today for a particular pipeline need.  

Totally amazing that for $99 and a generously donated UV Stepper script (updated in the past week to allow UV sets to be copied from one model to another) now provides me the ability to use Texture Atlases/Tiled Maps in conjunction with Lightmaps Baked from Cinema 4D to be viewed in Unity3D.

Having played with Cheetah3D for last couple of days it has an impressive feature list for the price.  Awesome. 

Thankyou,
Neil.
